verdict.rationale: LiveKit's own CLI can create tokens and the server uses JWT authentication, so it does issue credentials itself. Nothing in the evidence shows those tokens can be scoped to limited permissions or tied to an agent's least-privilege needs. Missing for 10: documented permission scoping or grants on tokens or API keys, per-agent credential issuance, revocation or expiry controls, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: server APIs, create tokens, generate test traffic, and scaffold and deploy agents.
Built for production, supports JWT authentication
